title: TaskResult
description: Message returned by a Holon to the Orchestrator upon task completion or failure.

attempt.description: Attempt counter matching claimed task (fencing verification).

job_epoch.description: Job epoch matching claimed task (split-brain verification).

worker_id.description: Identifier of the worker submitting the result.

origin_worker_id.description: Original source worker ID if bubbled through compound holons.

status.description: Execution outcome ('success', 'failure', 'cancelled', or custom skill status).

data.description: Result data validated against the skill's output_schema.

costs.description: Expense metrics reported by worker (tokens, compute_seconds).

created_at.description: Timestamp when result was produced (Unix epoch ms).

envelope_ts.description: Timestamp of envelope dispatch (Unix epoch ms).
